model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of knowledge probing editors, quantified by ACC (%), against co-occurrence number. The x-axis, labeled “Co-occurrence Number”, is a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ to 10³. Tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 10⁰, 10¹, 10², and 10³. The y-axis, labeled “ACC (%)”, is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 65. Tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 10, from 0 to 65. There are five lines displayed in the plot. The ‘Base’ line is green with circular markers and is solid; it begins at approximately 89.60% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and ends at approximately 89.60% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 10³. The ‘MEMIT’ line is red with triangular markers and is solid; it begins at approximately 86.21% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and ends at approximately 84.62% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 10³. The ‘IKE’ line is blue with square markers and is solid; it begins at approximately 84.52% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and ends at approximately 84.52% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 10³. The ‘ROME’ line is purple with diamond markers and is solid; it begins at approximately 72.50% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and ends at approximately 72.50% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 10³. The ‘FT’ line is orange with crosses and is solid; it begins at approximately 32.52% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and ends at approximately 76.10% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 10³.
